description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You decode a temporary copy of an executed spell into your spell cache. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell chip or spell gem, temporarily add the spell to your spell cache. It remains in your cache until you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Download Spell] to replace a prepared spell with the logged spell or until the next time you use Log Spell Execution. You can use this spellshape only to log spells that appear on the arcane spell list.
